evidence: Has the Validation label and updates validation time checks across `src/validation.cpp` and `src/validation.h` to query clock time via `ChainstateManager`.
rationale: Routes header future-time validation, IBD evaluation, and progress calculation through `ChainstateManager::Now()`, eliminating global system time queries. This makes validation logic safer to test in isolation and resolves a spurious second-boundary race condition in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks`.
